bullets.text: Crypto Travel Rule Enforced — The UK has implemented the Crypto Travel Rule, requiring Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASPs) to enhance transparency and combat financial crime in digital asset transfers.

AI Governance Changes Ahead — Singapore's Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is shifting towards stricter AI governance, requiring financial institutions to demonstrate compliance and effective oversight by 2026.
Regulatory Reporting Modernization — Capital markets organizations are urged to adopt configuration-driven reporting to enhance efficiency and reduce costs amid increasing regulatory scrutiny.

EU Supervisory Reporting Reform — The European Banking Authority is proposing significant changes to supervisory reporting, aiming to simplify processes while maintaining effective oversight and compliance.
Evolving Role of Chief Data Officers — Chief Data Offices must now demonstrate their value through strategic data management, focusing on operational efficiency and measurable business outcomes.
